title: eng-platform
text:
eng-platform

Lina: quick brainstorm: propose a "sideload-claim" topic to keep event envelopes small for high-qps tenants. thoughts?
Boris: fine but we need clear join semantics. what is acceptable join latency?
Lina: default 1s for enterprise, 200ms for PLG. make per-tenant config.
Devin: agree. reconciler will join raw events + claim topic within the window and emit settled attribution. dry-run first.
Boris: how do we audit? must persist raw claim stream + reconciler decisions to reconstruct billing.
Lina: plan: raw claim tail 3d, checkpoints weekly retained 1y. reconciler rebuild = checkpoints + 3d tail.
Devin: scoring: provenance_hint weight + freshness + source_reliability. include reasons in settled event.
Boris: add timeline API for support to fetch initial claim + settled decision for a req_fingerprint.
Lina: security: salt fingerprints per-tenant before emitting claim topic.
metering-bot: RFC draft: https://go/repo/sideload-claim (comments open) :eyes:
